title: Austin: Meet Future City Manager Candidates
summary:
*   **Public Forum:** Residents can attend a community forum to meet candidates for Austin's next City Manager.
*   **Engagement Opportunity:** This is an important chance for the public to learn about and engage with potential new city leaders.
*   **Information Only:** While Council members may be present, no official decisions or actions will be taken at this event.
transcript:
AUSTIN CITY COUNCIL 
COUNCIL DISCUSSION 
MONDAY, MARCH 25, 2024 AT 6:00 PM 
PERMITTING AND DEVELOPMENT CENTER 
     6310 WILHELMINA DELCO DR. AUSTIN, TX 
 
Meet the Candidates Event 
 
Attend a community forum for the residents to meet the City Manager candidates. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
A quorum of Council members may be present. No action will be taken. 
 
The City of Austin is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. 
Reasonable modifications and equal access to communications will be provided upon request. 
For assistance, please call 512-974-2210 or TTY users route through 711.
